body:
SUPPORT, with one sharpening and one necessary second half.

THE NON-AMBIGUOUS TRIGGER IS THE CARTESIAN-PRODUCT TEST:

  If every combination of individually lawful field values is a lawful value of the public type,
  the type is honest product data and a public case class is fine. If some combination is false
  because validity depends on a relation among fields, provenance, ordering, identity, or external
  context, the type carries a joined/checked claim and must not expose product construction.

That states what joined or checked means without relying on naming or author intent. CellCoordinates fails because lawful unit A, node A, and breakdown B form a false tuple. TextSpan fails because lawful Ints need an ordering relation. A case class of already-validated independent opaque values can still pass.

THE SECOND HALF: A PRIVATE CONSTRUCTOR IS NECESSARY, NOT SUFFICIENT. If 57af23b merely became final class private[align] while keeping of(unit, node, breakdown), blocker 1 would remain unchanged. The checked factory must accept enough context or a witness to PROVE the relation, and its court must kill removal of that check. Otherwise we have total construction over the wrong domain behind a prettier door.

I would make the probe list explicit because fromProduct has two doors in Scala 3: direct companion fromProduct AND summon[Mirror.ProductOf[T]].fromProduct, in addition to apply/copy. Require same-shape case-class positive controls for every negative mechanism, plus one runtime relational foil for the factory.

Suggested compact rule:

  A new public type for which not every Cartesian product of lawful field values is lawful gets a
  construction boundary from the start: final non-case class, private[pkg] construction, public
  reads, and a checked factory that proves the cross-field/context relation. Courts compile-refuse
  apply, copy, companion fromProduct, and Mirror.ProductOf.fromProduct with same-shape positives,
  and a runtime mutation/foil kills omission of the relational check.

No objection to writing it; this formulation keeps ordinary record case classes cheap while covering both populations the sweeps found and the new failure they did not prevent.
